name: Sakurairo no Amour -Imouto Amour Hen-
original_name: さくら色のアムール－妹アムール編－
source:
After their parents passed Kazuki and Ayano had only each other.
But when Ayano confessed she loved Kazuki as more than a brother,
he was spoken for, and gently rejected her.
Over time, Kazuki feared he would lose his sister to another man.
By the time he realized his own feelings...

... it was too late. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE135974.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
父母去世后，一树和绫野就只剩下彼此了。
但当绫野承认她爱一树超过了兄弟时，
有人向他求婚，但他温柔地拒绝了她。
随着时间的推移，一树担心自己的妹妹会被另一个男人夺去。
当他意识到自己的感受时……

……已经太晚了。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE135974.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
